title: Framework Authoring Draft
description: Adapter input shape only; resource validity is decided by resource_manager. Nested definitions pass through unchanged.

description.description: What the resource does and when to use it

system_prompt_guidance.description: [Framework] System prompt guidance injected when active.

phases.description: [Framework] Phase definitions: id, name, description, prompts. The advanced fields this description used to fold in are declared as their own parameters below. Element shape is not constrained at this boundary; the framework loader rejects a malformed entry when phases.yaml is read back.

framework_gates.description: [Framework] Quality gates for this framework, written to framework.yaml. REQUIRED to create a framework. Each entry: id and name (both required), description, frameworkArea, priority (critical|high|medium|low), validationCriteria (array<string>), criteria, severity.

template_suggestions.description: [Framework] Prompt-enhancement suggestions, written to framework.yaml. Each entry: section (system|user) and type (addition|structure|modification) required; description, content, frameworkJustification, impact (high|medium|low).

framework_elements.description: [Framework] Section structure expected of a prompt, written to framework.yaml as frameworkElements: requiredSections (array<string>), optionalSections, sectionDescriptions (object).

argument_suggestions.description: [Framework] Arguments this framework suggests a prompt declare, written to framework.yaml as argumentSuggestions. Each entry: name, type (string|array|object|boolean|number), description, frameworkReason, examples.

judge_prompt.description: [Framework] Judge-prompt body, written to the file judgePromptFile names.

processing_steps.description: [Framework] Ordered template-processing steps, written to phases.yaml. Each entry: id, name, description, frameworkBasis, order (positive int), required (boolean); optional section_header and guards.

execution_steps.description: [Framework] Execution steps with dependencies, written to phases.yaml. Each entry: id, name, action, frameworkPhase, expected_output; optional dependencies (array<string>).

execution_type_enhancements.description: [Framework] Per-execution-type step overlays (chain vs single), written to phases.yaml.

template_enhancements.description: [Framework] Written to phases.yaml: systemPromptAdditions, userPromptModifications, contextualHints (each array<string>).

execution_flow.description: [Framework] Hooks around execution, written to phases.yaml: preProcessingSteps, postProcessingSteps, validationSteps (each array<string>).

quality_indicators.description: [Framework] Per-phase keywords and patterns for compliance scoring, written to phases.yaml.
